The '''Kessel sector''' was a [[sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Kessel system]] was located within, which contained the [[planet]] [[Kessel]] and its infamous [[spice]] [[Spice mines of Kessel|mines]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> The Kessel Sector also contained the [[Aeneid system]], [[Injopan]], [[Mandrine]], [[Randa system|Randa]], [[Tilurus]], [[Zerm]],<ref name="Tales from Vandor">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]''</ref> and [[Oba Diah]] which headquarters of the [[Pyke Syndicate]], was also located in the sector.<ref name="Official Guide" />
